name: hep solar
note: German solar company (hep global GmbH, Güglingen); sleeve partner of VfB Stuttgart from 2023 to 2025/26. For 2026/27 the sleeve is taken over by GREENOX, so hep solar is no longer on the current home kit.
verdict: hep global GmbH is a privately held German solar group from Güglingen, founded by Christian Hamann and Thorsten Eitle and held via hep global holding GmbH. The shareholders are private individuals and holding companies with no state or club links worth scrutiny, and its VfB Stuttgart sleeve deal ended after 2025/26, so it is rated none.
